description: Turns the four parameters of the Spinner immediately to its left into CV outputs, with a vMIDI output beside them

params.text: Chooses the span the CV outputs cover: 0-10 gives 0V to 10V, 0-5 gives 0V to 5V, and -5-5 gives -5V to +5V

outputs.text: The Spinner parameter of the same number as a voltage in the span RANGE sets, slewed towards each new value in place of stepping to it
A vMIDI cable carrying the controller messages arriving from the hardware, for Kilpatrick's patchable MIDI modules rather than for a voltage input

notes: it goes immediately to the right of a Spinner and puts out nothing on its own
with Up/Down Mode on the four outputs stop carrying a level and pulse instead, +5V for a click of the encoder one way and -5V for a click the other, and RANGE no longer reaches them
menu: Settings — a heading over the two items under it
Up/Down Mode — makes the four outputs pulse to +5V or -5V on each click of the encoder in place of carrying a level
Raw MIDI Mode — sends the messages arriving from the hardware straight out of MIDI OUT in place of the repeated controller stream
